items.title: New release: Baby Audio SubCulture

items.title: Cherry Audio ESQ-1 celebrates 40 years of Ensoniq
items.body: Cherry Audio's Ensoniq ESQ-1 marks the 40th anniversary of the classic 1986 hardware synth — officially licensed in collaboration with Creative Technology, owner of the Ensoniq IP.
